rules: After restart, pending requests (parked in dispatch queue, no execution started) MUST be replayed.
Replay re-issues the prior result if upstream had already completed but the response was lost.
No upstream work is initiated post-restart (upstream already executed).
No lease / fencing is required: pending work has not crossed the boundary into upstream execution.
consumers: domains/dispatch pending queue replay on restart
validation_rules: pending lane MUST NOT issue new upstream calls
pending lane MUST emit a terminal event with the prior outcome
